text: APPROVE. The refactor splits the loop body into three helpers with the same checks in the same order, so each early `continue` becomes a `null` return, and by my count the new per-name method scores about 10, well under 15. I didn't build it, but I saw nothing that would trip warnings-as-errors. `EnclosingSection` is now recomputed per name instead of cached across the line, which should change only performance, not results.
